title: Officers keep saying 'don't worry about Michael Johnson'
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: some more and every time I ask about Michael Johnson they tell they kept telling me don't worry about Michael Johnson he's fine he's

plain: Mario Woods, who guarded nuclear weapons at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about an event in 1977 that he links to a UFO abduction. He says that afterward, every time he asked about a fellow airman named Michael Johnson, officers kept telling him not to worry, that Johnson was fine. If true, it would suggest the military was keeping quiet about what happened to both men.
